svg.title: SCP AI Agent — persistent RAG and tool orchestration
svg.desc: Option B indexes documentation into Azure AI Search and stores conversation history in Cosmos DB. An authenticated Fastify request enters LangGraph, retrieves hybrid search context, evaluates the question through a model proxy, and either responds or calls AWS, Azure and ServiceNow tools before evaluating again. The document compares Option A in-memory storage with Option B persistent storage. Graph checkpoint state remains in RAM in both designs.

g.text: SCP AI Agent. Context into action.
Option B / Persistent retrieval + conversation history / LangGraph orchestration
LANGGRAPH / RETRIEVE → EVALUATE → TOOLS OR RESPONSE
Cosine search in Node.js RAM; rebuild index after restart.
Chunks and chat sessions do not survive process restart.
OPTION B / AZURE AI SEARCH + COSMOS DB
Document index and stored conversation history persist.
Graph checkpoint state still lives in RAM.
